issues.message: Change must have at least one delta. No deltas found. Ensure your change has a specs/ directory with capability folders (e.g. specs/http-server/spec.md) containing .md files that use delta headers (## ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED/RENAMED Requirements) and that each requirement includes at least one "#### Scenario:" block. If this change intentionally modifies no specs (pure refactor, tooling, docs), set "skip_specs: true" in the change's .openspec.yaml instead. Tip: run "openspec change show <change-id> --json --deltas-only" to inspect parsed deltas.

issues.message: Requirement must have at least one scenario

Requirement must have at least one scenario. Scenarios must use level-4 headers. Convert bullet lists into:
#### Scenario: Short name
- **WHEN** ...
- **THEN** ...
- **AND** ...

Requirement "Foo SHALL be described" should contain SHALL or MUST in the requirement body, not only in the header. Move the SHALL/MUST statement to the line immediately after the "### Requirement: ..." header. (RFC 2119 best practice for English specs)
